# Rules

Everything this app's UI must not do, in one place. Read it before writing UI. A rule marked "review" has no script yet, so a reviewer checks it.

| ID | Rule | Answered on | Ground | Enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rule/arbitrary-value` | A Tailwind arbitrary value such as p-[13px] or bg-[#0f766e]. A transition property list, a CSS-wide keyword, a grid area name and math built only from tokens and env() pass | none yet |  | `scripts/check-system.mjs` |
| `rule/button-canonical-element` | When a surface needs a button, render Button rather than a raw <button> with its own class, because the replaced classes paint 6 different hover fills and 3 different radii by hand. | [components/button](docs/generated/components/button.md) | app | review `src/ui/Button.tsx` |
| `rule/button-label-verb` | When the label is written, use a verb the user recognizes in sentence case — Save, Delete, Zoom extents — because the label is the action's name and the accessible name comes from it. | [components/button](docs/generated/components/button.md) | single use | review `src/components/TopBar.tsx` |
| `rule/button-row-limit` | When one row or dialog footer holds more than 3 buttons, move the rest into a menu, because the measured composer toolbar holds 3 actions at 24px each and a fourth starts competing with the input. | [components/button](docs/generated/components/button.md) | measured | review `src/components/AssistantPane.tsx` |
| `rule/button-state-ladder` | When a button is hovered or pressed, step the fill one rung per state — .08 to .14 on hover, .14 to .20 on press — because a fill step reads as feedback without moving the label or the box. | [components/button](docs/generated/components/button.md) | measured | review `src/ui/ui.css` |
| `rule/button-variant-purpose` | When a surface needs a button, pick variant by the action's purpose — 1 primary per view, secondary for the default, ghost for a quiet action, danger for a destructive one — because two accent fills in one row leave no single action and Cursor's own default button is the quiet one. | [components/button](docs/generated/components/button.md) | app | review `src/ui/ui.css` |

| `rule/chip-interactive-only-with-handler` | When a chip runs an action, pass onClick so it renders as a <button>; when it is a fact, pass nothing so it stays a <span>, because a fact in the tab order adds a stop that does nothing. | [components/chip](docs/generated/components/chip.md) | app | test `src/ui/Chip.test.tsx` |
| `rule/chip-row-limit` | When a chip row holds more than 6 chips, wrap the row or move the rest behind a "More" chip, because the measured chip is 20px tall with 8px side padding and a 608px composer row fits 6 of them before the row wraps. | [components/chip](docs/generated/components/chip.md) | measured | review `src/components/CommandLine.tsx` |

## What the check can't see

A reviewer or a browser covers these. Passing `cd apps/ui && bun run check` says nothing about them.

- Rendered contrast, including non-text contrast of borders, focus rings and checkbox edges. Measure it in a browser.
- Behavior: what a click, Enter or Escape does, focus order and focus return, and whether Cancel submits.
- Layout at each viewport, overflow at 390px and touch target sizes.
- Visual overrides on components the registry does not list, and overrides built at runtime: cn() branches, spread props, a class name held in a variable.
- A loading state shown some other way than a label ternary on the button, such as a label read from a variable.
- Class names and values built at runtime, such as template strings, cn() branches or fontSize: size / 2.5.
- bg-white and text-black when the theme defines no role for their job, their opacity forms such as bg-black/50, and CSS keywords such as white in var() fallbacks.
- Files outside the include folders, and ui files missing from the drift list (they are scanned, but no hash guards them).
- Whether a token's role comment still matches how the token is used.
- Rules the generated rules page marks review, or enforces only through their own Check: clause.
- Motion that is only measured: exit slower than enter, frequent-surface motion, linear easing, press delay, input lag and jank. Easing set in script or through a variable, and hover reveals written as Tailwind classes (v4 guards hover: itself, v3 does not).
- Whether a pressed style covers the control whose tap highlight was removed: any pressed style in the repo passes trap/touch-tap-highlight.
